snippet.title: Final Night At Hotel - Official Short Trailer | Horror Game
snippet.description:
Final Night At Hotel is a horror game for up to 5 players. Together, you must investigate the creature haunting the hotel, collect clues, and vote each night for determine the strategy to defeat it. When night falls, your goal is clear: kill or exorcise the creature...

Wishlist & Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076980/Final_Night_At_Hotel/

Edited by cherubnotavailable on Discord

MUSIC:
Henry Burr - You Didn't Want Me When You Had Me
Quinten Coblentz - When Night Falls
